name: @bubble-ai/desktop
description: Bubble AI for Mac, Windows and Linux: the workspace in its own window, a hub on this computer, and this computer as a device for agents.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bubble AI uses your microphone when you call an agent.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Bubble AI uses this to send texts you approve through Messages, and to let your agents work on this Mac's screen when you lend it to them.
extendInfo.NSContactsUsageDescription: Bubble AI lets your agents look people up in Contacts when you turn on the Apple mod.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Bubble AI lets your agents read your calendar, and add or move events you approve, when you turn on the Apple mod.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Bubble AI lets your agents read your calendar, and add or move events you approve, when you turn on the Apple mod.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Bubble AI lets your agents read your reminders, and add or complete ones you approve, when you turn on the Apple mod.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Bubble AI lets your agents read your reminders, and add or complete ones you approve, when you turn on the Apple mod.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Bubble AI finds and connects to Bubble AI on your other computers over your own network.

author: Bubble AI contributors
